approved: R, 2026-10-07 (standing rule: images beat JSON when an approved pack's images and its values JSON disagree)
reason: The pack's sharedLook sky (#73A5CC zenith, #A2C4DC mid, #DBDCD1 horizon) is the pale house-contrast-v1 JSON that R corrected from that pack's heroes; the pack's own calibrated frames show the clear blue sky, so the frames win.
method: Sampled the nine calibrated frames in frames/ (01-lakeview, 02-brooklyn, 03-midtown, 04-san-francisco, 05-alley, 05-train, 06-sloans, 07-new-orleans, 08-miami). Sky pixels: b > r+25, b > g, b > 150, rows in the top 55 % of each frame; each frame's sky extent split into thirds; per-frame band median, then the median across frames: top third #7AAFE2 and middle third #8FBAE7 (9 frames each). Horizon: only the three frames whose sky reaches an unobstructed horizon (01 lakeview #A0CCF2, 02 brooklyn #94C7FA, 07 new-orleans #A2C8ED) give the per-channel median #A0C8F2; the other frames' lowest sky band is cut by buildings and haze and is excluded.
